bundlingNotes: This is a genuine, dollar-denominated escrow/settlement fee schedule (not premium-only), filed with and published by the Nevada Division of Insurance. Basic Escrow Services bundles document prep for 1 deed, e-doc download/printing, 2 wire transfers, 2 overnight deliveries, preliminary report/commitment ordering, closing statement/instructions prep, and in-office notary/signing -- all other services (sub-escrow, interest-bearing account setup, additional documents, third-party services, recording/transfer-tax charges) are itemized separately in a Miscellaneous Services table. Explicitly for use by First American and any title agency that elects to adopt these fees.
